mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.10% over 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.5 percentage points above 6.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.0% and rises by >0.5pp over 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a housing boom without broad-based manufacturing support, triggering sectoral imbalances that cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rising > 0.5% and INDPRO falling > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST rises >0.5% and INDPRO falls >0.3% over 1 month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 1.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing real rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL >5.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS rises >0.25pp, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 per month signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000 per month, or the Rank IC is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 5% signals a weakening housing market, reducing construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST declines >5% over 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates contraction in consumer demand amid monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falling > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS rising > 0.25pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS falls >0.5% and FEDFUNDS rises >0.25pp, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing slowdowns (INDPRO < 100.5), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced industrial output and weak economic growth signals.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.5, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.
